title: DOE intelligence director never briefed on nuclear-site UAP incursions

tellings.quote:
Well, I can I can say completely openly
and transparently when I was in DOE and
I was director of intelligence,
I never was briefed on any of that.

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA officer who ran intelligence at the Department of Energy from about 2005 to 2008, says nobody ever told him about UAP (the government's term for UFOs) showing up at nuclear sites. He tells Michels 'completely openly and transparently' that while he was there as director of intelligence, he 'never was briefed on any of that.' That matters because nuclear sites are part of what the Department of Energy is responsible for.
